policy.hint: A policy keeps the permissions of password protection under a name, to apply them again in one step. Passwords are never kept: they are typed when the policy is applied.
policy.name: Policy name
policy.needs_open_password: This policy asks for a password to open the document: type the open password.
policy.open_password_long: Ask for a password to open the document
sig.add_time_stamp: Add a time stamp from a time stamp server
sig.certify_3: Form filling, signing and comments allowed
sig.check_authority_failed: The stamp does not verify with the certificate of the authority
sig.check_authority_warning: The stamp verifies, but the authority is not in the trusted list
sig.check_identity_failed: The signature does not verify with the certificate, or the certificate was not valid at the signing time
sig.check_identity_warning: The signature verifies, but the certificate is not in the trusted list
sig.check_integrity_failed: The signed content was changed or the signature does not verify
sig.check_integrity_passed_material: The signed content is unchanged; later revisions only add validation material
sig.check_integrity_warning: The signed content is unchanged; later revisions changed the document
sig.check_integrity_warning_stamps: The signed content is unchanged; later revisions add document time stamps or validation material (the other changes of time stamp revisions are not analysed)
sig.check_revocation_failed: A certificate of the chain was revoked at or before the signing time
sig.check_revocation_not_checked: Not applicable: the certificate is self-signed or is itself in the trusted list
sig.check_revocation_not_checked_unread: Not checked: the signature cannot be read
sig.check_revocation_passed: No certificate of the chain was revoked at the signing time
sig.check_revocation_warning: Cannot be determined: for some certificates the revocation data are missing, too old, not verifiable, or the signing time is not proven
sig.check_time_failed: The time stamp is not valid
sig.check_time_passed: Proven by a valid time stamp of a trusted authority
sig.check_time_warning: Proven by a valid time stamp; the authority is not in the trusted list
sig.check_time_warning_none: Taken from the signer's computer: there is no time stamp
sig.material_intro: The certificates and the revocation data (OCSP answers, revocation lists) that the signatures need are added to the document security store (DSS) in a new revision, so they can be checked later without a network. The signatures stay valid. Only signatures whose signer is trusted get material. Save the document to keep it; this is not a claim of conformance to a long-term validation profile.
sig.material_no_servers: No server needs to be asked.
sig.material_offline: Online checks are off: only the data already in the document or fetched before are added.
sig.material_online: Ask the servers named in the certificates first (this also turns online revocation checks on for later validations)
sig.name: Name
sig.no_ids: There is no digital ID yet: import one (.pfx, .p12) or create a self-signed one.
sig.online_revocation: Check revocation online (OCSP and revocation lists)
sig.online_revocation_hint: Off unless you turn it on. When it is on, Validate All Signatures and Add Validation Material ask the OCSP responders and revocation list addresses written in the certificates, only for chains that end at a trusted certificate. No content of the document is sent: an OCSP request carries digests of the issuer and the serial number of the certificate, so the responder learns which certificate is checked; a revocation list is downloaded whole.
sig.password_hint: The password protects the private key: it is needed to import, create and use the ID.
sig.place_draw: Draw a rectangle on the page
sig.protected_note: The document is protected: the signed file is encrypted like it and opens with the same passwords. The signature itself (the signer's certificate and the time) stays readable without the password, as the PDF format requires.
sig.rev_basis_claimed: the time given by the signer, not proven
sig.rev_basis_now: now: the signing time is not known
sig.rev_basis_time_stamp: the time of a trusted time stamp
sig.rev_note_after_expiry: The revocation data were issued after the certificate expired and need not list it
sig.rev_note_another_certificate: the answer is about another certificate
sig.rev_note_bad_signature: The revocation data were changed or are not signed by their issuer
sig.rev_note_from_future: The revocation data are dated in the future
sig.rev_note_hold_unknown: The certificate was on hold; when the hold ended is not known
sig.rev_note_inconsistent_times: The OCSP answer gives the state of the certificate at a time after it was given
sig.rev_note_issued_before: The revocation data were issued before the time checked, so they cannot show the state at that time
sig.rev_note_issuer_missing: The certificate of its issuer is missing
sig.rev_note_no_data: There are no revocation data for this certificate
sig.rev_note_not_after_proof: The revocation data were issued before the signature is proven to exist (the signing time is not proven: a time stamp would prove it)
sig.rev_note_not_asked: not asked: the limit of requests or time of the check was reached
sig.rev_note_not_authorized: The revocation data are signed by an authority that may not give them
sig.rev_note_online_off: Not asked online: online revocation checks are off (Signatures pane › Options)
sig.rev_note_refused: The OCSP responder refused to answer
sig.rev_note_responder_not_valid: The certificate of the OCSP responder was not valid when it answered
sig.rev_note_responder_unchecked: The revocation of the OCSP responder's own certificate is not checked
sig.rev_note_signing_time_unknown: The signing time is not known, so a revocation before now cannot be judged
sig.rev_note_unknown_to_responder: The OCSP responder does not know this certificate
sig.rev_note_unreadable: The revocation data cannot be read
sig.rev_note_unsupported_list: A revocation list of a kind Folitecta does not read (delta, indirect, partitioned by reasons, or naming its distribution point relative to its issuer)
sig.rev_note_unsupported_ocsp: An OCSP answer of a kind Folitecta does not read
sig.rev_note_untrusted: The chain does not end at a trusted certificate
sig.rev_revoked_later: Revoked on {date} ({reason}), after the signing time
sig.revoked: Signature made with a revoked certificate
sig.signed_version_tip: Open the document as it was when it was signed
sig.subject: Subject
sig.time_stamp_intro: A document time stamp proves that the document existed as it is now at the time given by the server. The signatures already in the document stay valid.
sig.trusted_hint: Signatures made with these certificates, or with certificates they issued, are shown as trusted.
sig.ts_revoked: Time stamp made with a revoked certificate
sig.ts_valid_changed: Valid time stamp; the document was changed after it
sig.ts_valid_stamped: Valid time stamp; later revisions add document time stamps or validation material
sig.ts_valid_trusted: Valid time stamp of a trusted authority
sig.ts_valid_trusted_unchecked: Valid time stamp of a trusted authority; revocation cannot be determined
sig.ts_valid_unknown: Valid time stamp; the authority is not in the trusted list
sig.tsa_hint: Only a digest (SHA-256) of the signature or of the document is sent to the server, never the document itself.
sig.tsa_needed: Enter the address of the time stamp server.
sig.valid_changed: Valid signature; the document changed after signing
sig.valid_stamped: Valid signature; later revisions add document time stamps or validation material
sig.valid_trusted: Valid signature from a trusted signer
sig.valid_trusted_unchecked: Valid signature from a trusted signer; revocation cannot be determined
sig.valid_unknown: Valid signature; the signer's identity is not verified
